description: This file defines a React functional component 'SessionsByOrganization' that renders a responsive bar chart visualizing session counts grouped by organization name. It imports external charting components from 'recharts', as well as theme and color utilities, and includes internal logic for rendering tooltips, handling loading/error states, and truncating labels.

methods.name: truncateLabel
methods.description: Truncates a label string to a maximum length, appending an ellipsis if necessary.

methods.name: CustomTooltip
methods.description: A React component that renders a custom tooltip for the bar chart, displaying the organization name and session count.
